changelog:
Fixed Update (404 after saving settings).
Flip Comp 'layout only' rewritten: parented layers and big layers stay correct.
Flip Comp now flips guides; Crop shifts guides.
Update now uses your system proxy/VPN and shows the exact error. New Proxy field in Settings.
Crop now works with text and shape layers.
New: Flip Selected Layers (each layer in place).
New: Flip Comp option 'Keep objects unmirrored' (mirror the layout only).
